industrialProfits.note: NEW (checked 2026-11-01): JAN-SEP OFFICIAL RELEASE ADOPTED — Jev gate PASSED (has_new_data 0.93, source_quality 1.92). NBS (Oct 27, via CNBC/Morningstar-Dow Jones): Jan-Sep industrial profits +15.5% YoY (¥6.03T); September alone +14.4% — strongest monthly growth since June, rebounding from August's +4.2%. Electronics profits doubled (contributed 9.6pp of total growth); high-tech manufacturing +52.0% (25.5% of total industrial profit, +6.2pp); nonferrous metals +79.7%; chemicals +49.2%; electronic special materials profits more than tripled; semiconductor device equipment +51.7%; optical-fiber makers ~6x, optical-cable >2x on AI computing/data-center buildout; petroleum refining returned to profit (¥84.2B vs year-ago loss). Cost per 100 yuan of revenue -0.45 yuan; margin 5.68%. Prior week's Jan-Aug print (+15.7%, ¥5.27T; Aug +4.2%) remains on record below. PRIOR (checked 2026-10-04): OFFICIAL JAN-AUG RELEASE ADOPTED — Jev gate PASSED (has_new_data 0.86, source_quality 1.99). NBS (Sep 28, Xinhua/gov.cn): Jan-Aug industrial profits +15.7% YoY (¥5.27T); August alone +4.2% YoY — a fifth straight monthly slowdown. Electronics +110% (contributed 62% of total growth); high-tech manufacturing +54.7%; raw materials +47.3% (6.2pp); cost per 100 yuan of revenue down 0.41 yuan, margin 5.66% (+0.44pp). industrialProfits.note_zh: 新（核查于2026-11-01）：官方1-9月数据采信——Jev闸门通过（has_new_data 0.93、source_quality 1.92）。统计局（10月27日，经CNBC/道琼斯）：1-9月工业利润同比+15.5%（¥6.03万亿）；9月单月+14.4%——6月以来最强单月增速，较8月+4.2%大幅反弹。电子行业利润翻倍（贡献总增长9.6个百分点）；高技术制造+52.0%（占工业利润总额25.5%，同比提高6.2个百分点）；有色金属+79.7%；化工+49.2%；电子专用材料利润增逾两倍；半导体器件设备+51.7%；光纤制造商利润增近6倍、光缆翻倍以上——AI算力/数据中心建设拉动；石油加工业扭亏为盈（盈利842亿元）。每百元营收成本降0.45元；利润率5.68%。上周1-8月数据（+15.7%、¥5.27万亿；8月+4.2%）保留于下。 前情（核查于2026-10-04）：官方1-8月发布采信——Jev闸门通过（has_new_data 0.86、source_quality 1.99）。统计局（9月28日，新华社/gov.cn）：1-8月工业利润同比+15.7%（¥5.27万亿）；8月单月+4.2%——连续第五个月放缓。电子+110%（贡献总增长62%）；高技术制造+54.7%；原材料+47.3%（贡献6.2个百分点）；每百元营收成本降0.41元，利润率5.66%（+0.44个百分点）。营收¥93.09万亿（+6.6%）。8月PPI +3.8%；1-8月工业产出+5.3%。

fxSettlement.note: NEW (checked 2026-11-01): SEPTEMBER SAFE DATA ADOPTED — Jev gate PASSED (has_new_data 0.94, source_quality 1.98). SAFE (Oct 20) / Xinhua-SCIO (Oct 21): September bank FX settlement $294.2B, sales $238.0B — net settlement-and-sales surplus $56.2B (Aug: $48.5B). Non-bank cross-border net capital inflow $40.7B, down 35% from August's $62.4B; cross-border receipts+payments +9% MoM; Jan-Sep cumulative settlement $2.3776T vs sales $1.9835T. Li Bin: net inflows mainly from goods-trade receipts, services deficit stable; outbound direct investment rising, RMB's growing role as a financing currency. FX reserves end-Sep $3.4003T (-$38.1B). PRIOR (checked 2026-10-11): no new SAFE monthly release (September data due ~mid-Oct); August figures stand. SAFE data released Sep 15: commercial banks posted a net FX settlement-and-sales surplus of $48.5 BILLION in August; cross-border capital recorded a net inflow of $62.4B, up 4% month on month; non-bank cross-border receipts and payments totaled $1.5T; FX market trading value $3.9T. In early September the yuan hit a four-year high as export regions drew $87.23B net inflows.

chinaEvExports.note: NEW (checked 2026-11-15): OCTOBER CAAM DATA ADOPTED — Jev gate PASSED (has_new_data 0.93, source_quality 1.73). CAAM (released Nov 11, via Global Times/CnEVPost): October vehicle exports 1.066M (+60.2% YoY); NEV exports 606K (+140% YoY, +6% MoM) — first month above 600K, NEVs >50% of exports for a 5th straight month. Jan-Oct exports 9.271M, incl. 4.612M NEVs (+129%). CAAM deputy secretary-general Chen Shihua: full-year exports will exceed 10M units. Domestic wedge widens: October NEV sales a record 1.94M (+13.1%) but domestic NEV sales -8.6% — 11th straight monthly decline; exports were 31.2% of total NEV sales (vs 14.9% a year ago). BEV exports 374K (+130%), PHEV exports 233K (+160%). BYD sold 300K+ BEVs in a single month for the first time. September figures remain on record below.
chinaEvExports.note_zh: 新（核查于2026-11-15）：中汽协10月数据采信——Jev闸门通过（has_new_data 0.93、source_quality 1.73）。中汽协（11月11日发布，经环球时报/CnEVPost）：10月汽车出口106.6万辆（同比+60.2%）；新能源出口60.6万辆（+140%，环比+6%）——首破60万辆，连续第5个月占出口过半。1-10月出口927.1万辆，其中新能源461.2万辆（+129%）。中汽协副秘书长陈士华：全年出口将超1000万辆。国内楔形扩大：10月新能源销量创纪录194万辆（+13.1%），但国内新能源销量-8.6%——连续第11个月下滑；出口占新能源总销量31.2%（去年同期14.9%）。纯电出口37.4万（+130%）、插混出口23.3万（+160%）。比亚迪单月纯电销量首破30万辆。9月数据保留于下方记录。 NEW (checked 2026-10-18): SEPTEMBER CAAM DATA ADOPTED — Jev gate PASSED (has_new_data 0.86, source_quality 1.76). CAAM (released Oct 12): September vehicle exports 1.053M (+61.4% YoY, +4.2% MoM); NEV exports 571K (+160% YoY, +8.6% MoM) — NEVs >50% of exports for a 4th straight month. Jan-Sep exports 8.205M (+65.8%), incl. >4M NEVs (more than double YoY). CAAM expects 2026 total exports to exceed 10M units. CPCA per AP (Oct 12): passenger-car exports +64% YoY. Domestic mirror: September NEV sales 1.823M (+13.6%), NEV share of new-car sales record 61.6%, but domestic NEV sales -9.4% — export wedge keeps widening. EU trade chief Sefcovic: China-EU interim deal could CUT Chinese hybrid exports by ~half — trade-defence tightening. PRIOR (checked 2026-10-11): no new CAAM/CPCA September total yet; value held. Company-level September prints (SMM/CPCA, Oct): Chery overseas sales 207.8K (+45.6% YoY, record), BYD 180.7K (+154%), Geely 106.7K (+162%, 4th straight month >100K; full-year 1M target announced); GWM overseas >50% of volume. CPCA September passenger retail ~1.69M (-24.6% YoY), NEV retail ~1.11M (+10% MoM) — retail down ~29% YoY Sep 1-27 while NEV wholesale +7% YTD: the export wedge widens. PRIOR (checked 2026-09-27): no new export print; CPCA guidance September NEV retail ~1.11M, penetration 70.3% early month. NEW (checked 2026-09-20): AUGUST SET RECORDS AND CROSSED THE 2025 FULL-YEAR TOTAL. CAAM (released ~Sep 10): total vehicle exports 1.01M in August, +65.3% YoY — above 1M for a THIRD consecutive month; NEV exports 526K, up ~130% YoY and ~52.1% of total vehicle exports (above half for a third straight month); Jan-Aug NEV exports 3.435M (+124.3%) against total vehicle exports 7.153M (+66.7%). CPCA (Sep 8-9): passenger-car exports 888K (+77.8% YoY, -4.2% MoM) = 38% of automakers' total sales; passenger NEV exports 518K (+154.7%) = 58.4% of passenger exports, up 18pp YoY; BEVs 63.4% of NEV exports, PHEVs 32.9%, EREVs 3.7%. Top NEV exporters: BYD 183,746 (+130.8%, 35.4% share), Geely 69,910 (+440.2%), Chery 68,431 (+221.2%), Tesla China 36,119 (+38.7% YoY but -45.5% MoM, share down to 7.0% from 12.3%), Changan 28,323. Jan-Aug BYD 1,126,797 NEVs exported (+87.5%, 33.9% of market). Group totals: Chery 196,984 exports (+52.1%, 70.3% of its volume — first Chinese automaker past 7.18M cumulative exports); BYD 189,500 (record, 43% of group sales); Geely 110,094 (+205%, NEVs 70,600 = +446%); GWM 62,517. Electrek (Sep 10): China exported 6.2M passenger vehicles through August — already more than all of 2025 (6.1M) with four months to go; full-year track ~9-10M. Domestic mirror-image: CAAM total NEV sales +17.8% to 1.643M, a record 60.6% of all new vehicle sales, but DOMESTIC NEV sales fell 4.6% (domestic passenger NEV -8.2%); narrow passenger retail ~1.58M, down 20%+ YoY; NEV retail penetration 65.8%; wholesale is running ~2.7M units above retail YTD — the export/inventory wedge.
